rootCauseFix.defect: handler.py's subprocess.run() call passed no cwd=, so the worker.py subprocess inherited the Serverless handler container's own /srv/handler working directory instead of /srv/worker; gfpgan==1.3.8's GFPGANer.__init__ hardcodes a relative model_rootpath='gfpgan/weights' that facexlib==0.3.0's load_file_from_url resolves against the process's actual CWD, causing a cache-miss stdout print ("Downloading: ...") and an unauthorized runtime download attempt that corrupted the single-JSON-document stdout protocol handler.py depends on
rootCauseFix.fix: cwd=WORKER_DIR added to the one subprocess.run() call, where WORKER_DIR = os.path.dirname(WORKER[1]) ('/srv/worker') -- exactly one added keyword argument, no other functional change
